originalTitle: Trump switched planes in Turkey earlier this month because of threat from Iran proxy forces – report
summary: President flew to Ankara onboard Qatari-gifted jet, without advanced defenses, and flew home on old Air Force One
content: Donald Trump switched aircraft before departing Turkey earlier this month after US officials determined there was a credible threat from Iranian proxy forces targeting him and Air Force One, according to a new report from the New York Times. The threat surfaced while the US president was attending the Nato summit. He had arrived in Ankara onboard the new Qatari-donated Boeing 747-8, an aircraft that Trump acknowledged does not have the same advanced defensive systems as the older Air Force One. According to the anonymous sources who spoke to the Times, after US officials detected the threat, the Secret Service recommended that Trump change aircraft before leaving the country. He later announced he would depart on the older Air Force One instead. CBS News confirmed the New York Times reporting later Friday, citing unnamed US officials. According to CBS’s sources, the US Secret Service decided to switch planes after receiving intelligence involving a plan to fire a missile at the president’s aircraft. The newly reported details about the threat help explain why the White House quickly decided to swap aircraft. They also highlight ongoing security concerns surrounding the donated jet, which Trump had pushed to have ready for use as soon as possible. According to the report, US officials did not believe the Iranian proxy forces were specifically targeting the new Boeing 747-8. Instead, the intelligence indicated the threat was directed at Trump himself and whichever aircraft he was traveling on. The White House has been contacted for comment. Trump’s justice department had previously subpoenaed reporters at the New York Times over their coverage of the security risks involving the president’s Qatari-gifted Air Force One replacement, but the justice department has dropped, for now, those efforts. Earlier this month, it was reported that Trump flew part of the trip home from the Nato summit in Turkey aboard the older Air Force One after arriving on the new Qatari-gifted aircraft. At the time, Trump did not provide a detailed explanation for the switch, saying he would use the legacy aircraft “for old time’s sake”. He also said both planes would make a previously unscheduled stop at Royal Air Force Mildenhall, a base used by US troops, before returning to the US. Although Trump did not explain the reason for changing planes at the time, he has previously spoken about threats from Iran against his life, even going so far as to say he left standing orders for the US military to destroy Iran “at levels they’ve never seen before” if Tehran carries out its longstanding threats to kill him. The revelations also come as Trump reportedly mulls escalating attacks on Iran in the ongoing conflict after a ceasefire deal has recently broken down. ⁠Trump has vowed “major military punishment” for Tehran and its Houthi allies in Yemen, though he once again left open the door to a diplomatic deal with Iran. “We are talking to ⁠them. I think they’re being serious. I think … they are being by far the most serious that we’ve seen them, but that doesn’t mean we get there,” Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday. He added: “We’re locked and loaded. We’re ready to go.”
chineseTitle: 由于伊朗代理人势力的威胁，特朗普本月早些时候在土耳其调换了飞机——报告
chineseSummary: 总统乘坐卡塔尔赠送的喷气式飞机飞往安卡拉，没有先进的防御系统，然后乘坐旧空军一号飞回家
chineseContent: 据《纽约时报》最新报道，本月早些时候，在美国官员确定伊朗代理人部队对他和空军一号构成可信威胁后，唐纳德·特朗普在离开土耳其之前更换了飞机。这一威胁是在美国总统出席北约峰会时出现的。他乘坐卡塔尔捐赠的新型波音 747-8 飞机抵达安卡拉，特朗普承认这架飞机没有与旧空军一号相同的先进防御系统。据接受《泰晤士报》采访的匿名消息人士透露，在美国官员发现这一威胁后，特勤局建议特朗普在离开该国之前更换飞机。他后来宣布，他将乘坐旧的空军一号离开。哥伦比亚广播公司新闻周五晚些时候援引未透露姓名的美国官员的话证实了《纽约时报》的报道。据哥伦比亚广播公司消息人士透露，美国特勤局在收到涉及计划向总统专机发射导弹的情报后决定调换飞机。新报道的有关威胁的细节有助于解释为什么白宫迅速决定更换飞机。他们还强调了围绕这架捐赠飞机的持续安全担忧，特朗普敦促这架飞机尽快投入使用。报道称，美国官员并不认为伊朗代理人武装专门针对新型波音747-8。相反，情报表明威胁是针对特朗普本人以及他乘坐的任何飞机。已联系白宫请其置评。特朗普的司法部此前曾传唤《纽约时报》的记者，因为他们报道了总统卡塔尔赠予的空军一号替代者的安全风险，但司法部已经放弃了，因为他们报道了卡塔尔赠送的空军一号替代机的安全风险。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
